user.title: ZHA Tools
user.description: Add ZHA Tools. You can change the default timeout and retry behaviour of the reconfigure, re-interview and ping actions later from the integration options.

abort.already_configured: Already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.

init.title: ZHA Tools defaults
init.description: Default values used by the reconfigure, re-interview and ping actions when not overridden in the call.

reconfigure.name: Reconfigure ZHA device
reconfigure.description: Run a ZHA device reconfigure, retrying on failure, and return the resulting status. Works on a single device, or on all ZHA devices except the coordinator.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The ZHA device to reconfigure. Required unless All devices is turned on.

all_devices.name: All devices
all_devices.description: Reconfigure every ZHA device except the coordinator, one after another, continuing with the next device whatever the previous one reported. Cannot be combined with a device, and only one batched run can be in progress at a time.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Per-attempt timeout in seconds. Defaults to the configured value.

max_retries.name: Maximum retries
max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries after the first attempt. Defaults to the configured value.

retry_delay.name: Retry delay
retry_delay.description: Seconds to wait between attempts. Defaults to the configured value.

reinterview.name: Re-interview ZHA device
reinterview.description: Re-interview a ZHA device in place (rediscover its endpoints and clusters) without removing it from the network, retrying on failure. Safe: the device never leaves the network. Works on a single device, or on all ZHA devices except the coordinator.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The ZHA device to re-interview. Required unless All devices is turned on.

all_devices.name: All devices
all_devices.description: Re-interview every ZHA device except the coordinator, one after another, continuing with the next device whatever the previous one reported. Cannot be combined with a device, and only one batched run can be in progress at a time.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Per-attempt timeout in seconds. Defaults to the configured value.

max_retries.name: Maximum retries
max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries after the first attempt. Defaults to the configured value.

retry_delay.name: Retry delay
retry_delay.description: Seconds to wait between attempts. Defaults to the configured value.

ping.name: Ping ZHA device
ping.description: Check that a ZHA device answers, retrying on failure. Also pings devices ZHA currently marks unavailable, so an answer brings them back; before the first retry, the device's network address is looked up once. Safe: the device is only read from. Works on a single device, or on all ZHA devices except the coordinator.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The ZHA device to ping. Required unless All devices is turned on.

all_devices.name: All devices
all_devices.description: Ping every ZHA device except the coordinator, one after another, continuing with the next device whatever the previous one reported. Cannot be combined with a device, and only one batched run can be in progress at a time.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the device to answer each ping. Defaults to the configured value.

max_retries.name: Maximum retries
max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries after the first attempt. Defaults to the configured value.

retry_delay.name: Retry delay
retry_delay.description: Seconds to wait between attempts. Defaults to the configured value.

rejoin.name: DANGER: rejoin ZHA device
rejoin.description: Ask a ZHA device to leave the network and immediately rejoin it (a remote substitute for the pairing button). DANGER: if the device firmware ignores the rejoin flag it will leave and not return, needing a manual re-pair. Prefer Re-interview unless a full rejoin is truly needed.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The ZHA device to ask to leave and rejoin.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be set to true to actually run the rejoin, acknowledging the device may leave the network and need a manual re-pair. The action refuses to run otherwise.

rejoin_wait.name: Rejoin wait
rejoin_wait.description: Seconds to wait for the device to return before reporting. 0 returns immediately without checking the outcome.
